statement.zh: 陀罗维拉于 2021 年以「Dholavira: a Harappan City」列入教科文世界遗产名录（名录 1645）；遗产命名≠考古定论。
statement.en: Dholavira was inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List in 2021 as “Dholavira: a Harappan City” (no. 1645); heritage title ≠ archaeological verdict.
